correctness.rationale: All homomorphism cases and CRT prime powers are exhausted in the proof; the congruence for commuting retractions follows directly from their compositions. The local counting bijection proves arbitrary tuple-arity formulas, while exact graph distances and cliques follow from coordinate-label geometry. Exhaustive relator and composition checks for 16 finite dicyclic groups independently confirm cases; these tests are not confused with an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The all-arity compatibility product gives the exact number of simultaneously realizable retraction families in every finite dicyclic group, a natural compatibility invariant of quotient splittings; the graph exhibits a sharp transition from empty/isolated to diameter three and has a complete maximal-clique classification. This is more than a routine individual homomorphism enumeration and applies across arbitrarily many distinct prime-power factors.
